prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent PNG illustration for the right half of a MetaTrader 5 website section.
Use the user-attached image as the visual reference. Recreate ONLY its right-side artwork very faithfully: a large polished 3D MetaTrader 5 emblem consisting of three interlocking rounded human-like forms, green at top, gold at lower left, blue at lower right, all with silver metallic beveled outlines. A circular silver-white medallion in front has a dimensional gold numeral "5". Around the emblem are a few small floating translucent rounded square tiles with red/green candlesticks and blue rising bar/line charts, matching the reference's positions and visual style. Underneath is the subtle floating elliptical glass pedestal/ring from the reference.
Composition: nearly square, emblem centered and large, all tiles and pedestal inside frame, generous clean edges. Premium high-detail 3D product render, glossy colored glass/enamel and chrome reflections.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no green background, no rectangle, no baked backdrop. It will be composited over either a lime green gradient or bright blue gradient using CSS.
No heading, no body copy, no QR code, no ratings, no stars, no app store or play store buttons, no watermark. Only text is the single numeral "5".
